يقترعون (form VIII)
# يَقْتَرِعُونَ (yaqtariʕūna) /jaq.ta.ri.ʕuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِقْتَرَعَ (iqtaraʕa)
# يُقْتَرَعُونَ (yuqtaraʕūna) /juq.ta.ra.ʕuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَرَعَ (iqtaraʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
